title: Jensen Huang is out at Nvidia — who is Colette Kress, his interim replacement?
lede: Nvidia CFO Colette Kress is now interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member, while the board searches for a permanent successor.

points: Huang, CEO for 33 years, left with no succession plan after reports of affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
Kress joined Nvidia in September 2013 after finance roles at Cisco and 13 years at Microsoft.
As CFO she has been a regular voice on earnings calls, so analysts already know her.
In a statement she said Nvidia stays focused on accelerated computing, AI and serving customers and developers.
Nvidia reports quarterly earnings on Tuesday, where more on her plans is expected.
